# Production Engineering Rules

Treat this repository as a production commercial product.
- Inspect architecture before editing.
- Preserve working functionality.
- No placeholder or dead UI.
- Prefer root-cause fixes.
- Preserve SEO, accessibility, responsiveness, security, and performance.
- Reuse existing patterns and avoid unnecessary dependencies.
- Validate inputs and handle loading, empty, success, and error states.
- Never expose secrets or credentials.

A task is complete only when affected code is consistent, existing behavior is preserved, and available checks pass.
